title: Platform administration
subtitle: Global governance — users, workspaces, scopes
usersCount: {count, plural, =0 {No users} one {# user} other {# users}}
workspacesCount: {count, plural, =0 {No workspace} one {# workspace} other {# workspaces}}
membershipsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No membership} one {# membership} other {# memberships}}
superuserOnlyBody: The platform administration console is restricted to superusers. It provides a global governance view — never access to the content of spaces.
governanceNote: This console governs users, workspaces and scopes. It exposes no content (documents, chats, analyses): a superuser administers the platform without accessing the content of the spaces.
workspacesWithAnomalies: {count, plural, =0 {No workspace} one {# workspace} other {# workspaces}} with anomalies (of {total})
createWorkspaceSubtitle: A first owner is required. They become the owner of the new scope.
assignOwnerSubtitle: The user will become owner of this workspace. This operation creates a new authorization scope.
allowAdditionalOwner: This workspace already has an owner — allow an additional owner (creates a second scope).
promoteToOwner: If the user is already a non-owner member, promote them to owner.
addMemberSubtitle: A non-owner member must be attached to an existing owner scope.
noOwnerAssignFirst: This workspace has no owner. Assign an owner first.
attachToScopeSubtitle: “{name}” will be attached to the selected owner. Their access to spaces of other scopes may become invalid.
accessesWillBeRevoked: These accesses will become invalid and will be revoked (kept in history):
reasonRequiredDisable: A reason is required for deactivation.
reactivateWorkspaceSubtitle: The workspace will become accessible again.
deactivateWorkspaceSubtitle: The workspace will become inaccessible to users and tasks. No data will be deleted.
chooseSourceTarget: Choose a different source and target.
transferPreviewSubtitle: Preview only. Effective application is not available in this version.
transferNeedsTwoOwners: A transfer requires at least two owners (scopes) in this workspace.
transferApplicable: ✓ Transfer applicable (but application is not available here).
transferNote: The application of a transfer (effective move) is not exposed in this version. Use this preview then the management commands under operator control.
reactivateAccountSubtitle: The account will be able to sign in again.
deactivateAccountSubtitle: The account will no longer be able to sign in. No data is deleted.
disableOwnAccountWarning: You are about to deactivate your own account.
promotionViaAssign: Promotion to owner goes through “Assign an owner”.
chooseAttachScope: Choose the owner scope to attach to.
editRoleSubtitle: Promotion to owner is not available here (use “Assign an owner”).
accessesExceedRole: These accesses exceed the new role and will be revoked:
removeFromWorkspaceSubtitle: The member will lose access to this workspace. The last owner cannot be removed.
memberHasActiveGrants: This member has active accesses that will be revoked:
quotaCountInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and {max}.
quotaSizeInvalid: Enter a positive size up to {max}.
quotaExceededNotice: This workspace is over its quota. Uploads are blocked until usage falls below the limit.
editQuotaSubtitle: Adjust the file count and total size limits for this workspace.
reductionBelowUsageWarning: The new limit is below the current usage. Existing documents remain available, but new uploads will be blocked until usage falls below the new limit.
quotaSaveError: The quota could not be saved.
